description: Presidential Secretariat - Amended Ex. Gaz. No. 1933/13 dated 21.09.2015, and further amended with effect from 28.03.2018 in the manner set out in the schedule
reasoning: This gazette notification contains both specific government personnel (President Maithripala Sirisena) and detailed portfolio responsibilities. It amends the assignment of functions, duties, and institutions to various ministers, including specific subject areas and responsibilities for each ministerial portfolio. The content includes both "who" (the President exercising constitutional powers) and "what" (detailed descriptions of ministerial responsibilities, institutions under each ministry, and specific subject matter oversight), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
